integrity: The proof separates the degree roles, analyzes refinement waves along equal rim sectors, and isolates the m=3 degree-coincidence exception. A standalone checker recomputes both the depth formula and the stable orbit partition on 1652 parameter pairs.
scientific limitations: Only ordinary one-dimensional color refinement from the uniform coloring is treated.
The theorem assumes the standard equally spaced Jahangir graph with n>=2 and m>=3; the wheel boundary n=1 is excluded.
The finite checker covers n<=60 and m<=30; the infinite result rests on the sector-distance proof.
No independent literature audit has been performed.
title: Exact color-refinement depth of Jahangir graphs
